title: Port hikeScore with 64-row sheet regression test
description:
js/hikeScore.js exports hikeScore(hike): ((lengthKm*1000 + gainM*2) / (10/timeHrs)) * 2^difficulty * 2^accessibility / quality / 1000. tests/hikeScore.test.mjs checks every Local.csv row against its sheet Score to 2 decimals.

Acceptance: `node --test tests/` passes with 0 mismatches; formula exists in exactly one file.

From docs/plans/0001-hiker-web-app.md, section "Components > hikeScore".

comments.author: Claude
comments.text: Done: 64/64 sheet Scores match. Run with node --test "tests/*.test.mjs" (Node 25 rejects the bare directory).
